# varnish_cdn_service (Resource)

A CDN service: a set of origins and domains deployed to the CDN.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "varnish_cdn_service" "web" {
  domain {
    fqdn = "www.example.com"
    tls  = true
  }

  # An apex domain needs a subdomain. This serves www.example.org, and
  # example.org redirects to it.
  domain {
    fqdn      = "example.org"
    subdomain = "www"
    tls       = true
  }

  # Wildcard domains are supported.
  domain {
    fqdn = "*.example.com"
    tls  = true
  }

  origin {
    name       = "default"
    host       = "origin.example.com"
    port       = 443
    enable_tls = true
    is_default = true
  }

  # Wizard configuration. Declare only the leaves you want to manage: the rest
  # keep tracking the server. What the fields mean is documented at
  # https://www.varnish-cdn.com/docs/configuration.
  settings = {
    general = {
      uncacheable        = false # false = caching enabled
      first_byte_timeout = "30s"
      allow_methods      = ["GET", "HEAD"]
    }

    # Settings applied only to requests matching the given extensions or paths.
    overrides = [
      {
        name       = "cache-images-long"
        extensions = ["jpg", "png", "webp"]
        rules = [
          { string_id = "general.cacheableTTLOverride", value = jsonencode("7d") },
        ]
      },
    ]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `deployed` (Boolean) Whether the service is deployed. Services auto-deploy on create.
- `domain` (Block List) Domains served by this service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--domain))
- `origin` (Block List) Origin servers for the service. Exactly one should be marked is_default. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--origin))
- `settings` (Attributes) Wizard (caching/security/routing) configuration. Every leaf is optional and computed: leaves you do not set keep tracking the server, so unmanaged parts of the wizard never show as drift. Removing a leaf you previously set does not revert it, it only stops managing it. An omitted field tracks the service's current value, which starts from its wizard answer template default; terraform plan and import show the effective values. What the fields mean is documented at https://www.varnish-cdn.com/docs/configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))
- `wizard_answer_template_id` (Number) Wizard answer template id used at creation time. Defaults to the latest available template when omitted. Available ids come from the varnish_cdn_wizard_templates data source (answerTemplates[].id). Changing it recreates the service, except when state holds no value yet (services created before the API recorded the template id report none): setting it then only adopts it into state.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Server-assigned service identifier.
- `name` (String) Service name. Set from the first domain at creation. It can be renamed in the UI.
- `origin_secret` (String, Sensitive) Shared secret the CDN sends to origins.
- `status` (String) Service status (deployed/undeployed/unknown).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339).

<a id="nestedblock--domain"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domain`

Required:

- `fqdn` (String) Fully-qualified domain name. Wildcards (e.g. "*.example.com") are supported.

Optional:

- `cert_id` (Number) Certificate id attached to the domain. Leave unset to use the CDN's automatic (ACME) certificate. Removing cert_id from an existing domain does not detach the certificate, it keeps the one already attached. Set cert_id to another certificate instead.
- `subdomain` (String) Required when fqdn is an apex domain such as example.com, and not allowed otherwise. The service is served on subdomain.fqdn, e.g. www.example.com, and the apex redirects to it. Accounts without apex redirect support reject it. There, set fqdn to the host name to serve instead.
- `tls` (Boolean) Whether TLS is enabled for the domain.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Server-assigned domain identifier.
- `is_cdn` (Boolean) Whether this is the generated CDN domain.
- `status` (String) Domain verification status.
- `txt_record` (String) TXT record value for domain verification.
- `verified_at` (String) Verification timestamp (RFC3339).


<a id="nestedblock--origin"></a>
### Nested Schema for `origin`

Required:

- `host` (String) Origin hostname or IP.
- `name` (String) Origin name.
- `port` (Number) Origin port (e.g. 80 or 443).

Optional:

- `allow_insecure_tls` (Boolean) Skip origin TLS certificate verification.
- `enable_tls` (Boolean) Connect to the origin over TLS.
- `host_header` (String) Host header to send to the origin.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default origin.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = varnish_cdn_service.web
  identity = {
    id = "42"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier, the same value as the id attribute.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Services are imported by their service ID.
terraform import varnish_cdn_service.web 42

# Older services may have no wizard_answer_template_id. Setting it after import
# does not recreate the service.
```
